title: Henan
capsule: The Kingdom of Henan was created by Xiang Yu in 206 BC for Shen Yang, a subordinate of the Zhao chancellor Zhang Er, who was granted the territory around Luoyang, the old Zhou royal domain that Qin had annexed two generations earlier. It was among the smaller and shorter-lived of the Eighteen Kingdoms established after the Qin dynasty's collapse. In 205 BC, amid the Chu–Han Contention, Shen Yang surrendered to Liu Bang, and Henan was absorbed as a commandery of the nascent Han dynasty.
